title: Causal Inference in Metric Spaces via Distance Profiles
abstract: arXiv:2610.33491v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern interventions increasingly produce object-valued outcomes, such as distributions, covariance matrices, networks, and trees. Existing causal frameworks often exploit special geometry such as one-dimensional Wasserstein quantiles or geodesic Fr\'echet means, whereas metric statistics studies random objects without confounding adjustment. We propose the profile causal effect $\Delta(\omega,t)$, which describes where and at what scale a treatment shifts probability mass, including changes in dispersion, tails, or structure that leave mean-level summaries unchanged. Formally, $\Delta(\omega,t)=\Pr\{d(\omega,Y(1))\le t\}-\Pr\{d(\omega,Y(0))\le t\}$ contrasts the potential-outcome probabilities of the same anchor-centered metric ball and requires no structure beyond the metric. translated_title: 基于距离轮廓的度量空间因果推断
translated_abstract: 现代干预措施日益产生对象值结果，例如分布、协方差矩阵、网络和树。现有的因果框架往往利用特殊几何结构，如一维 Wasserstein 分位数或测地 Fréchet 均值，而度量统计则在无混杂调整的情况下研究随机对象。我们提出了轮廓因果效应 Δ(ω,t)，它刻画了处理在何处以及以何种尺度移动概率质量，包括那些不改变均值层面汇总信息的离散度、尾部或结构上的变化。形式上，Δ(ω,t)=Pr{d(ω,Y(1))≤t}−Pr{d(ω,Y(0))≤t} 对比了以同一锚点为中心的度量球下潜在结果的概率，且仅需距离度量而无需其他结构假设。在由确定性或辅助设计固定的网格上，我们将交叉拟合的双重稳健得分与高维高斯近似以及多重……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了仅依赖距离度量即可定义的“轮廓因果效应”Δ(ω,t)，用以刻画处理在空间位置和尺度上如何移动概率质量（包括均值不变时的离散度、尾部与结构变化），并结合交叉拟合双重稳健得分与高维高斯近似实现统计推断。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the profile causal effect Δ(ω,t), defined solely through distances to an anchor, which captures where and at what scale treatment shifts probability mass (including dispersion, tail, and structural changes invisible to mean-level summaries), with inference enabled by cross-fitted doubly robust scores and high-dimensional Gaussian approximation.
